title: Bletchingley
extract: Bletchingley (historically "Blechingley") is a village in Surrey, England. It is on the A25 road to the east of Redhill and to the west of Godstone, has a conservation area with medieval buildings and is mostly on a wide escarpment of the Greensand Ridge, which is followed by the Greensand Way.

title: Graeme Hendrey Wood
extract: Graeme Hendrey Wood is a  10-hectare (25-acre) nature reserve east of Bletchingley in Surrey. It is managed by the Surrey Wildlife Trust.

title: Tilburstow Hill
extract:
Tilburstow Hill  is a  9-hectare (22-acre) nature reserve south-east of Godstone in Surrey. 
This is a semi-natural broadleaved wood on the Greensand Ridge, with sweet chestnut, sessile and pedunculate oak, beech, silver birch and hazel.

title: Godstone Ponds
extract: Godstone Ponds is a 13.6-hectare (34-acre) biological Site of Special Scientific Interest in Godstone in Surrey. Bay Pond is an educational nature reserve closed to the public which is managed by the Surrey Wildlife Trust.
categories: Category:Sites of Special Scientific Interest in Surrey

title: Tandridge
extract: Tandridge is a village and civil parish in the Tandridge District, in the county of Surrey, England. Its nucleus is on a rise of the Greensand Ridge between Oxted and Godstone.

title: Hazelwood School
extract:
Hazelwood School is a private preparatory school in Limpsfield, Surrey, England.
The school was established in 1890 as a boarding school for boys aged 8–13 by Ruth and Edward Baily.

title: Tandridge Priory
extract: Tandridge Priory was a priory in Surrey, England.

title: Scord's Wood and Brockhoult Mount
extract:
Scord's Wood and Brockhoult Mount is a 252.3-hectare (623-acre) biological Site of Special Scientific Interest west of Sevenoaks in Kent. Scord's Wood is a Nature Conservation Review site, Grade I.
This sloping site has the best sessile oak stands in the county.
categories: Category:Sites of Special Scientific Interest in Kent

title: Ide Hill
extract: Ide Hill  is a village within the civil parish of Sundridge with Ide Hill, in the Sevenoaks District of Kent, England.  It stands on one of the highest points of the Greensand Ridge about three miles south-west of Sevenoaks.

title: One Tree Hill and Bitchet Common
extract:
One Tree Hill and Bitchet Common is a 79.2-hectare (196-acre) biological Site of Special Scientific Interest east of Sevenoaks in Kent. It is in Kent Downs Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty and One Tree Hill is managed by the National Trust
This site has mixed woodland on the Lower Greensand, some of it of ancient origin.
categories: Category:Sites of Special Scientific Interest in Kent

title: Yopps Green
extract: Yopps Green is a hamlet in the Tonbridge and Malling district, in the county of Kent, England. It is part of the small village of Plaxtol.

title: Bourne Alder Carr
extract:
Bourne Alder Carr is a 13.4-hectare (33-acre) biological Site of Special Scientific Interest east of Sevenoaks in Kent.
The River Bourne runs through a shallow valley, and frequent flushing of the woodland on the banks with water rich in nutrients creates a rich ground flora.
categories: Category:Sites of Special Scientific Interest in Kent

title: Basted, Kent
extract: Basted is a hamlet in the Tonbridge and Malling district, in the county of Kent, England.

title: Wrotham Heath
extract: Wrotham Heath  is a settlement in the borough of Tonbridge and Malling in Kent, England. It is part of the civil parish of Wrotham, and is approximately 2 miles (3.2 km) south-east of the village of Wrotham, 7 miles (11 km) east of Sevenoaks, and 7 miles (11 km) west of Maidstone.
